name: optcatalog_emit_qsand_impact_event
description: OptCatalog::EmitQSandImpactEvent builds and dispatches a quicksand event for terrain-deforming hit nodes.
known_limits: The smoke target covers the hit-node terrain flag gate, quicksand relay rejection, disabled quicksand rejection, enabled dispatch into quicksand InstanceEvent cleanup, radius-mode execution, and vertex-merge epsilon restoration; success-side quicksand geometry persistence remains covered through accepted zDEClient quicksand feature targets.
The original leaves EAX incidental and known callers ignore it, so the source helper is modeled as void pending the coherent OptCatalog source-cluster tier S pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4b0660 validates ECX as OptCatalogEntryDef*, EDX as OptCatalogHitEventPartial*, hitNode flag mask 0x10000 gate, CopyQSandEventTemplateDefaults call, hitPos-to-center copy, fixed radius clamp against g_OptCatalogMaxCraterRadius, random radius from craterRadiusBase plus (rand() * craterRadiusRandomRange >> 15), damageOwnerNode stack argument copy, and dispatch to zDEClient_QSand::InstanceEventMaybeRelay.

The native OptCatalog smoke verifies unflagged hit nodes do not call the quicksand relay, flagged hit nodes build enough event state to reach the accepted quicksand relay path, relay rejection and disabled quicksand return through the accepted dependency, enabled dispatch reaches InstanceEvent failure cleanup, and both radius branches leave vertex-merge epsilon restored.
